website.note: Corporate site lists commercial diagnostic blood tests (Nodify XL2, Nodify CDT, GeneStrat ddPCR, GeneStrat NGS, VeriStrat). No therapeutic-drug pipeline page.

ctgov.note: Three trials returned (1 PHASE3 COMPLETED, 2 PHASE2 TERMINATED/WITHDRAWN) but lead sponsors are AVEO Pharmaceuticals and ETOP IBCSG Partners Foundation; Biodesix's role was diagnostic-test partner, not asset owner. All excluded per workflow rules (terminated/withdrawn or partner-owned). Biodesix-run studies (ALTITUDE NCT04171492, CLARIFY NCT06728319, INSIGHT NCT03289780) are clinical-utility studies of its own diagnostic tests, not interventional drug trials.

development_pipeline_diagnostics: ROR & MRD Combination Test (pan-cancer; ddPCR, with MSKCC)
VeriStrat - immunotherapy use (pan-cancer MSI-H, with MSKCC)
ESR1 Monitoring - HR+/HER2- breast cancer (Bio-Rad ddPLEX ESR1 IVD)
commercial_product.note: Biodesix is a diagnostic-test company. All in-development pipeline items are new diagnostic tests / IVDs, not therapeutic drugs.

excluded_legacy_terminated.note: ctgov returned 3 trials linked to BDSX as collaborator: 1 PHASE3 COMPLETED, 1 PHASE2 TERMINATED, 1 PHASE2 WITHDRAWN. None active and none are BDSX-owned therapeutic assets.

excluded_partner_owned.note: Trials sponsored by AVEO Pharmaceuticals and ETOP IBCSG Partners Foundation in which Biodesix participated as a biomarker/diagnostic-test collaborator. Biodesix did not own the therapeutic asset; excluded per workflow rule 4.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Diagnostics-only company. Biodesix develops and markets blood-based laboratory-developed tests (LDTs) and IVDs for lung-cancer diagnosis, treatment guidance, and monitoring. It does not develop therapeutic drugs. Its ongoing clinical studies (ALTITUDE, CLARIFY, INSIGHT) are clinical-utility evaluations of its own diagnostic tests, not interventional therapeutic Phase 1/2/3 trials.
